shortBio.en: Arctic Monkeys frontman; Sheffield lyric detail and guitar from Whatever People Say onward.
shortBio.zh: Arctic Monkeys 主唱；从《Whatever People Say》起的谢菲尔德细节歌词与吉他。

body.en: Born 1986, Sheffield. Principal writer and vocalist. Early records lean on local detail and tight guitar; later albums stretch arrangement and delivery.
body.zh: 1986 年生于谢菲尔德。主要写歌与主唱。早期唱片偏本地细节与紧吉他；后期专辑拉开编曲与唱法。
